example: They had to abandon the car in the snow.
description: 他們不得不把車遺棄在雪地裡。

example: She decided to study abroad next year.
description: 她決定明年去國外留學。

example: It is the absolute truth.
description: 這是絕對的事實。

example: This noise level is not acceptable.
description: 這種噪音程度是不可接受的。

example: I will accompany you to the hospital.
description: 我會陪你去醫院。

example: The report was very accurate.
description: 這份報告非常準確。

example: They accused him of stealing the money.
description: 他們指控他偷了那筆錢。

example: He acknowledged that he had made a mistake.
description: 他承認他犯了一個錯誤。

example: The company has acquired a new business.
description: 該公司收購了一項新業務。

example: What was the actual cost of the project?
description: 專案的實際費用是多少？

example: You need to adapt to the new environment.
description: 你需要適應新環境。

example: Do you need any additional information?
description: 你需要任何額外資訊嗎？

example: We must address the problem immediately.
description: 我們必須立刻處理這個問題。

example: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
description: 學校決定採用一種新的教學方法。

example: We need to plan in advance.
description: 我們需要預先計畫。

example: She is interested in world affairs.
description: 她對國際事務很感興趣。

example: We ate dinner and went home afterward.
description: 我們吃了晚餐，然後（之後）就回家了。

example: He works for an advertising agency.
description: 他在一家廣告代理商工作。

example: What's on the agenda for today's meeting?
description: 今天會議的議程是什麼？

chinese: 具侵略性的、積極進取的
example: He has a very aggressive dog.
description: 他有一隻非常有侵略性的狗。

example: The country received foreign aid after the earthquake.
description: 地震後該國收到了外國援助。

example: The aircraft landed safely on the runway.
description: 飛機安全降落在跑道上。

example: The news alarmed many people.
description: 這消息讓許多人感到驚恐。

example: We had to alter our plans at the last minute.
description: 我們不得不在最後一刻修改計畫。

example: The bill amounted to $200.
description: 帳單總計兩百美元。

example: Today is our wedding anniversary.
description: 今天是我們的結婚週年紀念日。

example: She is anxious about the job interview.
description: 她對工作面試感到焦慮。

example: The reason for his failure was apparent.
description: 他失敗的原因很明顯。

example: Apparently, the meeting has been canceled.
description: 顯然地，會議已經取消了。

example: This kind of music has a wide appeal.
description: 這種音樂有廣泛的吸引力。

example: We need a new approach to this problem.
description: 我們需要一個處理這個問題的新方法。

example: This dress is not appropriate for a funeral.
description: 這件衣服不適合參加葬禮。

example: The project needs the manager's approval.
description: 專案需要經理的批准。

example: My parents don't approve of my new boyfriend.
description: 我父母不同意（不贊成）我的新男友。

example: A new problem has arisen.
description: 一個新問題出現了。

example: There was an armed guard at the bank.
description: 銀行有一名武裝警衛。

example: The police found a collection of illegal arms.
description: 警方發現了一批非法武器。

example: This juice has no artificial colors.
description: 這種果汁沒有添加人造色素。

example: You should be ashamed of yourself.
description: 你應該為自己感到羞愧。

example: Put your books aside for a moment.
description: 先把你的書放在一旁。

example: Every aspect of the plan was carefully considered.
description: 計畫的每個方面都被仔細考慮過。

example: We need to assess the situation carefully.
description: 我們需要仔細評估情況。

example: The final assessment will be based on your exam results.
description: 最終評估將根據你的考試成績而定。

example: Most people associate summer with the beach.
description: 大多數人將夏天與海灘聯想在一起。

example: There are many risks associated with smoking.
description: 吸菸會帶來許多相關的風險。

example: He is a member of the medical association.
description: 他是醫學協會的成員。

example: Let's assume that he is telling the truth.
description: 讓我們假設他在說實話。

example: He made an attempt to break the world record.
description: 他嘗試打破世界紀錄。

example: My attorney will handle the legal documents.
description: 我的律師會處理法律文件。

example: The government is backing the new project.
description: 政府正支持這項新計畫。

example: Some bacteria are good for your health.
description: 有些細菌對你的健康有益。

example: He was barred from the club for fighting.
description: 他因為打架而被禁止進入該俱樂部。

example: Language can be a barrier to communication.
description: 語言可能成為溝通的障礙。

example: Basically, I agree with everything you said.
description: 基本上，我同意你所說的一切。

example: She is battling a serious illness.
description: 她正與嚴重的疾病搏鬥。

example: I can't bear the pain anymore.
description: 我再也無法忍受這種疼痛了。

example: Can you feel the beat of the music?
description: 你能感受到音樂的節拍嗎？

example: The situation is beyond our control.
description: 情況超出了我們的控制範圍。

example: We will bill you for the services next month.
description: 我們下個月會寄帳單給您。

example: He felt bitter about losing his job.
description: 他對失去工作感到憤恨不平。

example: Don't blame me for your mistakes.
description: 不要把你的錯誤歸咎於我。

example: He has been blind since birth.
description: 他自出生以來就失明了。

example: There is a strong bond between the two sisters.
description: 這兩姊妹之間有著深厚的感情聯繫（紐帶）。

example: France borders Germany.
description: 法國與德國接壤。

example: The concert was broadcast live on TV.
description: 音樂會在電視上現場直播。

example: We need to stay within our budget.
description: 我們需要維持在預算範圍內。

example: The bullet hit the wall.
description: 子彈擊中了牆壁。

example: He bought a bunch of flowers for his wife.
description: 他買了一束（串）花給他的太太。

example: She has a small burn on her finger.
description: 她的手指上有個小燙傷。

example: A rabbit jumped out of the bush.
description: 一隻兔子從灌木叢裡跳了出來。

example: Everyone but Joe attended the meeting.
description: 除了喬以外，每個人都參加了會議。

example: You should calculate the cost of the materials before buying them.
description: 在購買材料之前，你應該先計算它們的成本。

example: The concert was canceled because the singer was ill.
description: 音樂會因為歌手生病而取消了。

example: Smoking is the leading cause of lung cancer.
description: 吸菸是導致肺癌的主要原因。

example: She is capable of running the entire department by herself.
description: 她有能力獨自管理整個部門。

example: The theater was filled to capacity last night.
description: 昨晚劇院座無虛席（達到了容量上限）。

example: The police managed to capture the thief after a short chase.
description: 警察在短暫追逐後成功捕捉到了小偷。

example: The film has an all-star cast.
description: 這部電影擁有全明星的演員陣容。

example: He made a brilliant catch in the final minutes of the game.
description: 他在比賽最後幾分鐘做了一次精彩的接球。

example: The dog was chained to a post in the yard.
description: 這隻狗被用鏈條鎖在院子的柱子上。

example: She was chosen to chair the committee meeting.
description: 她被選中主持委員會會議。

example: The chairman opened the meeting with a brief speech.
description: 主席以簡短的發言拉開了會議的序幕。

example: I challenge you to a game of chess.
description: 我挑戰你跟我下一盤西洋棋。

example: What are the main characteristics of this species?
description: 這個物種的主要特徵是什麼？

example: The explorers charted the path of the river.
description: 探險家們繪製了這條河流的路徑圖。

example: The chief problem we face is a lack of funding.
description: 我們面臨的主要問題是缺乏資金。

example: I cannot help you under these circumstances.
description: 在這種情況下，我無法幫助你。

example: The student cited many sources in her research paper.
description: 這名學生在她的研究論文中引用了許多來源。

example: The government is responsible for protecting its citizens.
description: 政府有責任保護其公民。

example: The lawyer specializes in civil law.
description: 這位律師專攻民法（民事法律）。

example: This is a classic example of modern architecture.
description: 這是現代建築的一個經典範例。

example: The manager is following the situation closely.
description: 經理正密切（仔細地）關注局勢的發展。

example: The peace talks collapsed after several days of arguing.
description: 在爭論數日後，和平談判崩潰（破裂）了。

example: The drink is a combination of fruit juices.
description: 這種飲料是多種果汁的結合。

example: She tried to comfort the crying child.
description: 她試圖安慰那個哭泣的孩子。

example: The soldiers followed the general's command.
description: 士兵們服從了將軍的命令。

example: He earns a commission on every car he sells.
description: 他賣出的每一輛車都能賺取佣金。

example: I have a commitment to finish this work by Friday.
description: 我承諾在週五前完成這項工作。

example: The committee decided to postpone the event.
description: 委員會決定推遲活動。

example: It is commonly believed that exercise is good for health.
description: 人們普遍認為（通常相信）運動對健康有益。

example: The university built a new research complex.
description: 大學建造了一座新的研究綜合設施。

example: The rules of the game are very complicated.
description: 這個遊戲的規則非常複雜。

example: Oxygen is a major component of air.
description: 氧氣是空氣的主要成分。

example: Loud noises can affect your concentration.
description: 大聲的噪音會影響你的專注力。

example: She explained the basic concepts of physics to us.
description: 她向我們解釋了物理學的基本概念。

example: The pollution of the river is a major concern.
description: 河流污染是一個主要的擔憂（關心的問題）。

example: The parents are concerned about their child's future.
description: 父母們對孩子的未來感到擔心。

example: The company is conducting a survey on customer satisfaction.
description: 公司正在執行一項關於客戶滿意度的調查。

example: He has a lot of confidence in his own abilities.
description: 他對自己的能力非常有信心。

example: There is a conflict between the two reports.
description: 這兩份報告之間存在衝突（矛盾）。

example: The instructions are very confusing.
description: 這些說明令人感到非常困惑。

example: The law was passed by congress last month.
description: 這項法律上個月由國會通過。

example: I became conscious of someone following me.
description: 我察覺到有人在跟蹤我。

example: He has very conservative views on social issues.
description: 他對社會議題有非常保守的觀點。

example: Please take my suggestions into consideration.
description: 請將我的建議納入考慮。

example: The results are consistent with our previous findings.
description: 結果與我們之前的發現是一致的。

example: The dog needs constant attention.
description: 這隻狗需要持續不斷的關注。

example: He is constantly complaining about his job.
description: 他不斷地在抱怨他的工作。

example: The bridge was constructed in the 19th century.
description: 這座橋是在 19 世紀建造的。

example: The road is closed due to construction work.
description: 這條路因建造（施工）工程而關閉。

example: She studies contemporary English literature.
description: 她研究當代英國文學。

example: He won first prize in the singing contest.
description: 他在歌唱比賽中獲得了一等獎。

example: You must sign the contract before starting work.
description: 你在開始工作前必須簽署合約。

example: Many people contributed money to the charity.
description: 許多人向慈善機構捐助了金錢。

example: He made a significant contribution to the scientific research.
description: 他對這項科學研究做出了重大的貢獻。

example: They converted the old barn into a house.
description: 他們將舊穀倉轉變成（改建成）了一棟房子。

example: I am convinced that he is telling the truth.
description: 我確信他是在說實話。

example: The core of the problem is a lack of communication.
description: 問題的核心是缺乏溝通。

example: The company is looking for a new corporate headquarters.
description: 公司正在尋找新的公司（企業）總部。

example: The local council has decided to build a new park.
description: 當地議會已決定建造一個新公園。

example: There are several major cities in this county.
description: 這個郡（縣）內有幾個主要城市。

example: It takes a lot of courage to speak in front of a large audience.
description: 在大群觀眾面前演講需要很大的勇氣。

example: The car was badly damaged in the crash.
description: 汽車在撞擊（車禍）中嚴重受損。

example: The creation of the Internet has changed the world.
description: 網際網路的創造改變了世界。

example: The ocean is full of strange creatures.
description: 海洋充滿了奇怪的生物。

example: The researchers are credited with discovering the new vaccine.
description: 研究人員被歸功於發現了這種新疫苗。

example: The plane's crew made sure all passengers were safe.
description: 飛機的全體機組人員確保了所有乘客的安全。

example: The country is facing a serious economic crisis.
description: 國家正臨嚴重的經濟危機。

example: What are the criteria for selecting the winner?
description: 評選獲勝者的標準是什麼？

example: The film received mixed reviews from the critics.
description: 這部電影收到了評論家們褒貶不一的評價。

example: The first few hours after surgery are critical.
description: 手術後的最初幾個小時是關鍵的。

example: The government's plan has faced a lot of criticism.
description: 政府的計劃面臨了許多批評。

example: It's easy to criticize other people's work.
description: 批評別人的工作很容易。

example: Rice is the main crop in this region.
description: 稻米是該地區的主要農作物。

example: Education plays a crucial role in a person's life.
description: 教育在一個人的一生中扮演著至關重要的角色。

example: We heard a cry for help from the garden.
description: 我們聽到花園傳來一聲呼救的喊叫。

example: Doctors are searching for a cure for the common cold.
description: 醫生們正在尋找治療普通感冒的療法。

example: The swimmer was swept away by a strong current.
description: 游泳者被一股強勁的水流沖走了。

example: The road has many sharp curves.
description: 這條路有許多急轉彎（曲線）。

example: The knife has a curved blade.
description: 這把刀有一個彎曲的（弧形）刀刃。

example: The documents were dated back to the sixteenth century.
description: 這些文件的年代可以追溯到十六世紀。

example: The parliament is holding a debate on the new tax law.
description: 議會正在就新的稅法進行辯論。

example: The company is struggling to pay off its heavy debts.
description: 這家公司正努力償還其沉重的債務。

chinese: 正派的、體面的、還不錯的
example: I just want to find a decent job with a good salary.
description: 我只是想找一份體面且薪水不錯的工作。

example: The government has declared a state of emergency.
description: 政府已宣布進入緊急狀態。

example: The number of tourists has declined significantly this year.
description: 今年遊客的人數顯著下降了。

example: They are planning to decorate the room for the party.
description: 他們計畫為了派對來裝飾房間。

example: The Christmas decorations were put up in early December.
description: 聖誕裝飾物在十二月初就掛起來了。

example: We need to decrease our spending on luxury items.
description: 我們需要減少在奢侈品上的支出。

example: I was deeply moved by the kindness of the strangers.
description: 我被陌生人的善意深深地打動了。

example: The army was defeated in a decisive battle.
description: 軍隊在一場決定性的戰鬥中被擊敗了。

example: The lawyer is preparing to defend his client in court.
description: 律師正準備在法庭上為他的當事人辯護。

example: The country is increasing its spending on national defense.
description: 國家正在增加其在國防上的支出。

example: The train was delayed for two hours due to a technical fault.
description: 由於技術故障，火車延遲了兩個小時。

example: The speech was a deliberate attempt to provoke the audience.
description: 這場演說是一次故意的企圖，旨在挑釁觀眾。

example: I believe he deliberately ignored my email.
description: 我相信他故意無視了我的電子郵件。

example: The store offers free delivery on orders over fifty dollars.
description: 該商店對超過五十美元的訂單提供免費遞送服務。

example: There is a high demand for organic vegetables these days.
description: 現今對有機蔬菜的需求很高。

example: The experiment was designed to demonstrate the effects of heat.
description: 這個實驗旨在示範（證明）熱度的影響。

example: He denied taking the money from the safe.
description: 他否認從保險箱裡拿了錢。

example: She felt depressed after failing the exam.
description: 她在考試不及格後感到很沮喪。

example: The news about the environment is very depressing.
description: 關於環境的消息非常令人沮喪。

example: The divers reached a depth of thirty meters.
description: 潛水員們達到了三十公尺的深度。

example: The village was deserted after the volcano erupted.
description: 火山爆發後，這個村莊就被遺棄（荒廢）了。

example: After all that hard work, you deserve a long holiday.
description: 在做了那麼多努力之後，你值得擁有一個長假。

example: He has a strong desire to travel the world.
description: 他有著環遊世界的強烈渴望。

example: They were desperate for food and clean water.
description: 他們非常急迫地需要食物和乾淨的水。

example: The report details the events leading up to the accident.
description: 該報告詳述了導致事故發生的各項事件。

example: The police provided a detailed description of the suspect.
description: 警方提供了關於嫌疑犯的詳細描述。

example: The smoke alarm is designed to detect even small fires.
description: 煙霧報警器旨在偵測即使是很小的火災。

example: The dog was digging a hole in the backyard.
description: 這隻狗正在後院挖一個洞。

example: The teacher maintains strict discipline in the classroom.
description: 老師在教室裡維持著嚴格的紀律。

example: We cannot discount the possibility of further delays.
description: 我們不能忽視進一步延遲的可能性。

example: The boss dismissed him for being late three times.
description: 老闆因為他遲到三次而解僱了他。

example: The new products are on display in the window.
description: 新產品正在櫥窗裡展示。

example: The organization distributes food to the poor.
description: 該組織將食物分發給窮人。

example: The map shows the distribution of the population.
description: 地圖顯示了人口的分佈情況。

example: There is a deep divide between the two political parties.
description: 這兩個政黨之間存在著深的分歧。

example: She works in the sales division of the company.
description: 她在公司的銷售部門工作。

example: The film documents the lives of rare animals in the wild.
description: 這部電影記錄了野外稀有動物的生活。

example: The airline handles both domestic and international flights.
description: 這家航空公司同時處理國內和國際航班。

chinese: 支配、統治、在...中占首要地位
example: One large company dominates the local market.
description: 一家大公司支配了當地市場。

example: The price of oil showed a downward trend this month.
description: 本月油價呈現下降趨勢。

example: I bought a dozen eggs from the market.
description: 我從市場買了一打雞蛋。

example: He is working on the first draft of his new book.
description: 他正在起草他新書的第一稿。

example: I had to drag the heavy suitcase across the floor.
description: 我不得不把沉重的行李箱在地板上拖過。

example: There has been a dramatic increase in sales recently.
description: 最近銷量有了劇烈的增長。

example: It took her several hours to edit the final chapter of the book.
description: 她花了幾個小時來編輯這本書的最後一章。

example: The second edition of the textbook includes new research.
description: 這本教科書的第二版包含了新的研究內容。

example: The new heating system is much more efficient than the old one.
description: 新的暖氣系統比舊的高效得多。

example: The charity provides support for elderly people living alone.
description: 這個慈善機構為獨居的老年人提供支援。

example: The citizens will elect a new president next month.
description: 公民們將在下個月選出一位新總統。

example: The price is high here, so I might look for it elsewhere.
description: 這裡的價格很高，所以我可能會去別處找找看。

example: New evidence has emerged during the police investigation.
description: 在警方調查期間，出現了新的證據。

example: The reunion with her family was a very emotional moment.
description: 與家人重逢是一個非常激動人心的時刻。

example: The school puts a lot of emphasis on creative writing.
description: 這間學校非常強調創意寫作。

example: I want to emphasize the importance of finishing the work on time.
description: 我想強調準時完成工作的重要性。

example: This software will enable you to create professional videos.
description: 這款軟體將使你能夠製作專業的影片。

example: We encountered some unexpected problems during the project.
description: 我們在專案期間遇到了一些意想不到的問題。

example: The teacher tried to engage the students in the discussion.
description: 老師試圖讓學生參與到討論中。

example: The new lighting will enhance the beauty of the room.
description: 新的燈光將增強房間的美感。

example: Please ensure that all the windows are closed before leaving.
description: 請在離開前確保所有的窗戶都已關閉。

example: She showed great enthusiasm for her new job.
description: 她對她的新工作表現出了極大的熱情。

example: The audience was very enthusiastic and clapped loudly.
description: 觀眾非常熱情，並大聲鼓掌。

example: I spent the entire day cleaning the house.
description: 我花了整整一天的時間打掃房子。

example: I am not entirely convinced by his explanation.
description: 我並不完全相信他的解釋。

example: In terms of talent, she has no equal in the field of music.
description: 就天賦而言，她在音樂領域沒有對手（平等的人）。

example: The company was established in 1950.
description: 這間公司成立於 1950 年。

example: He left his entire estate to his daughter.
description: 他將全部遺產留給了他的女兒。

example: The experts estimate that the project will take two years.
description: 專家估計這個專案將花費兩年的時間。

example: There are serious ethical issues involved in this research.
description: 這項研究涉及嚴重的倫理問題。

example: The committee will evaluate the candidates' performances.
description: 委員會將評估候選人們的表現。

example: The two teams were very even in terms of skill.
description: 這兩支球隊在技術上非常勢均力敵（相等）。

example: The story is about the struggle between good and evil.
description: 這個故事是關於善與惡之間的鬥爭。

example: The doctor gave the patient a thorough physical examination.
description: 醫生為病人進行了全面的身體檢查。

example: He made up a clever excuse for being late.
description: 他為遲到編造了一個聰明的藉口。

example: She is a high-level executive in a large corporation.
description: 她是一間大公司的高階主管。

example: The museum will exhibit the artist's latest paintings.
description: 博物館將展出這位藝術家的最新畫作。

example: Scientists are studying the existence of life on other planets.
description: 科學家們正在研究其他星球上生命存在的可能性。

example: Please exit the building through the back door.
description: 請由後門離開這棟建築。

example: The results of the test met our expectations.
description: 測試結果符合我們的預期。

example: The company will pay for your travel expenses.
description: 公司將支付你的旅遊（差旅）費用。

example: Space exploration has led to many scientific discoveries.
description: 太空探索帶來了許多科學發現。

example: The investigation exposed a lot of corruption in the government.
description: 調查揭露了政府中的許多腐敗行為。

example: The deadline for the project has been extended by one week.
description: 該專案的截止日期已延長了一週。

example: I agree with you to a certain extent.
description: 在某種程度上我同意你的觀點。

example: The external walls of the house need to be painted.
description: 房子的外牆需要粉刷。

example: She has an extraordinary talent for playing the piano.
description: 她在彈鋼琴方面有著非凡的天賦。

example: He tends to go to extremes in his political views.
description: 他的政治觀點傾向於走極端。

example: The whole project ended in total failure.
description: 整個專案以完全失敗告終。

example: I have full faith in your ability to succeed.
description: 我對你成功的能力充滿信心。

example: The current tax system tends to favor the wealthy.
description: 目前的稅收制度傾向於偏袒富人。

example: The bird preened its feathers after the rain.
description: 雨後那隻鳥正在整理它的羽毛。

example: The university has decided to increase tuition fees.
description: 大學已決定調漲學費（教育費）。

chinese: 飼料、(資訊)饋送 (v. 為 A2) (p. 4)
example: We need to buy more cattle feed for the winter.
description: 我們需要為冬天購買更多牲畜飼料。

example: We welcome feedback from our customers to improve our service.
description: 我們歡迎客戶提供回饋意見，以改善我們的服務。

example: I love the feel of silk against my skin.
description: 我喜歡絲綢貼在皮膚上的觸感。

example: She is highly respected by her fellow scientists.
description: 她深受同事（科學家同伴）的尊敬。

example: We figured that it would be cheaper to take the bus.
description: 我們認為（計算後覺得）搭公車會比較便宜。

chinese: 歸檔、提出(訴訟等) (n. 為 B1) (p. 4)
example: The company filed for bankruptcy last month.
description: 這間公司上個月提出了破產申請。

example: The project was financed by a government grant.
description: 該專案是由政府撥款資助的。

chinese: 調查或研究的發現、結果 (p. 4)
example: The report’s findings suggest that the problem is getting worse.
description: 報告的調查結果顯示問題正在惡化。

example: He works for a leading law firm in the city.
description: 他在市內一家頂尖的律師事務所（公司）工作。

chinese: 解決方法、困境 (v. 為 A2) (p. 4)
example: There is no quick fix for the nation’s economic problems.
description: 國家的經濟問題沒有快速的解決方法。

example: The house was engulfed in flames within minutes.
description: 幾分鐘內這棟房子就被火焰吞沒了。

example: A flash of lightning lit up the night sky.
description: 一道閃電照亮了夜空。

example: We offer flexible working hours to our employees.
description: 我們為員工提供靈活的（有彈性的）工作時間。

example: The empty bottle floated on the surface of the water.
description: 空瓶子漂浮在水面上。

example: The paper had a deep fold down the middle.
description: 這張紙中間有一道很深的摺痕。

example: We brought some folding chairs for the picnic.
description: 我們為野餐帶了一些可摺疊的椅子。

example: Following the meeting, a short press conference was held.
description: 會議之後（在...之後），舉行了一場簡短的記者會。

example: I can’t forgive him for what he did to me.
description: 我無法原諒他對我所做的事。

example: The former president attended the opening ceremony.
description: 前任總統出席了開幕典禮。

example: He made a fortune by selling his software company.
description: 他藉由出售軟體公司賺了一大筆財富。

chinese: 向前的、前衛的 (adv. 為 A2) (p. 5)
example: The company is looking for a forward-thinking manager.
description: 公司正在尋找一位具有前瞻（向前）思維的經理。

example: The university was founded in the early nineteenth century.
description: 這所大學成立於十九世紀初。

example: The hostages were finally freed after two weeks.
description: 人質在兩週後終於被釋放了。

example: Everyone should have the freedom to express their opinions.
description: 每個人都應該有表達意見的自由。

example: The frequency of the bus service has been increased.
description: 公車服務的頻率（班次次數）已經增加了。

chinese: 為...提供燃料、激起 (n. 為 B1) (p. 5)
example: The scandal fueled public anger against the government.
description: 這起醜聞激起了公眾對政府的憤怒。

example: I fully understand the situation you are in.
description: 我完全理解你所處的情況。

chinese: 運作、起作用 (n. 為 B1) (p. 5)
example: The machine stopped functioning properly after the power cut.
description: 停電後這台機器停止了正常運作。

example: The research is funded by several large corporations.
description: 這項研究是由幾間大公司資助的。

example: There are fundamental differences between the two theories.
description: 這兩種理論之間存在著根本的差異。

example: The project is struggling due to a lack of funding.
description: 由於缺乏資金（經費），該專案正陷入困境。

example: The house is beautiful; furthermore, it’s in a great location.
description: 這棟房子很漂亮；此外，它的位置也很好。

example: The company has gained a large share of the market this year.
description: 該公司今年獲得了巨大的市場份額。

example: The police are investigating the activities of a local gang.
description: 警方正在調查當地一個幫派的活動。

example: The new wind farm will generate enough electricity for the whole town.
description: 新的風力發電場將為整個城鎮產生充足的電力。

example: My favorite genre of movies is science fiction.
description: 我最喜歡的電影類型是科幻片。

example: The store sells a wide range of household goods.
description: 這家店販售各式各樣的家庭用品（貨物）。

example: The country is governed by a coalition of several parties.
description: 這個國家由幾個政黨組成的聯盟所治理。

example: The governor signed the new law yesterday.
description: 州長昨天簽署了這項新法律。

example: He grabbed his bag and ran out of the door.
description: 他抓起提包跑出了門。

example: The eggs are graded by size before being packed.
description: 雞蛋在包裝前會按大小進行分級。

example: The weather is gradually getting warmer.
description: 天氣正逐漸變暖。

example: The hotel has a grand staircase in the lobby.
description: 這家飯店的大廳有一座宏偉的樓梯。

example: The government has decided to grant a visa to the refugee.
description: 政府已決定准予該難民簽證。

example: The manufacturer guarantees the product for one year.
description: 製造商對該產品保證（保固）一年。

example: The manager is experienced enough to handle the crisis.
description: 經理非常有經驗，足以處理（應對）這場危機。

example: Pollution can cause serious harm to the environment.
description: 污染會對環境造成嚴重的傷害（損害）。

example: These chemicals are harmful to human health.
description: 這些化學物質對人體健康是有害的。

chinese: 聽力、聽證會 (v. 為 A1)
example: The committee held a public hearing on the new law.
description: 委員會就這項新法律舉行了公開聽證會。

example: The beautiful island was like a piece of heaven.
description: 這座美麗的小島就像一片天堂。

example: She wore a pair of shoes with high heels.
description: 她穿著一雙高跟（鞋跟）鞋。

example: The soldiers described the war as a living hell.
description: 士兵們將戰爭描述為人間地獄。

chinese: 高點、最高水平 (adj. 為 A1)
example: The price of oil reached a new high last month.
description: 油價上個月達到了新的高點（最高水平）。

example: The car hire for the weekend cost more than I expected.
description: 週末的汽車租用費用比我預期的要多。

example: She kept a firm hold on her child's hand.
description: 她牢牢地握住（掌握）著孩子的手。

example: The trunk of the old tree was hollow.
description: 那棵老樹的樹幹是空心的。

example: The city is a holy place for many people.
description: 這座城市對許多人來說是一個神聖的地方。

example: It is a great honor to be invited to this ceremony.
description: 受邀參加這個典禮是一項極大的榮譽。

example: The country will host the next Olympic Games.
description: 這個國家將主辦下一屆奧林匹克運動會。

example: Many households are struggling with rising energy costs.
description: 許多家庭正努力應對不斷上漲的能源支出。

example: The city is facing a serious housing shortage.
description: 這座城市正面臨嚴重的住房短缺。

example: He has a great sense of humor and makes everyone laugh.
description: 他非常有幽默感，總是讓大家發笑。

example: The book is a humorous account of his travels.
description: 這本書是他旅遊經歷的幽默記錄。

example: The police are on a hunt for the escaped prisoner.
description: 警方正對逃犯進行搜尋。

example: Many people are opposed to hunting for sport.
description: 許多人反對將狩獵作為運動。

example: The divorce caused a lot of emotional hurt.
description: 離婚造成了許多情感上的傷害（痛苦）。

example: We should strive to reach our political ideals.
description: 我們應該努力達成我們的政治理想。

example: The teacher used a diagram to illustrate the process.
description: 老師用圖表來詳細說明（闡明）這個過程。

example: The book is full of beautiful illustrations.
description: 這本書充滿了漂亮的插圖。

example: The writer has a very vivid imagination.
description: 這位作者有著非常豐富（生動）的想像力。

example: The driver became impatient with the traffic jam.
description: 司機對塞車感到不耐煩。

example: The report implies that the crisis is getting worse.
description: 報告暗示（意指）這場危機正在惡化。

example: The government has imposed a new tax on luxury goods.
description: 政府已對奢侈品強制執行（課徵）新稅。

example: He tried to impress his boss with his hard work.
description: 他試圖用辛勤的工作來讓老闆留下深刻印象。

example: I was very impressed by her piano performance.
description: 我對她的鋼琴表演印象非常深刻。

example: The water level rose by one inch overnight.
description: 水位一夜之間上升了一英吋。

example: The police are investigating the incident that happened last night.
description: 警方正在調查昨晚發生的事件。

example: Many families are struggling with a low income.
description: 許多家庭正因低收入而苦苦掙扎。

example: It is becoming increasingly difficult to find a job.
description: 找工作正變得越來越（漸增地）困難。

example: The city is a major industrial center in the country.
description: 這座城市是該國主要的工業中心。

example: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for the infection.
description: 醫生開了抗生素來治療這項感染。

example: Please inform the manager of any changes to the schedule.
description: 若行程有任何變動，請告知（通知）經理。

example: Our initial reaction to the news was shock.
description: 我們對這則消息的最初反應是震驚。

example: Initially, the plan seemed very simple.
description: 最初（起初），這個計畫看起來非常簡單。

example: The government has launched a new initiative to reduce poverty.
description: 政府發起了一項減少貧困的新倡議（行動）。

example: She managed to find inner peace through meditation.
description: 她透過冥想成功找到了內心的平靜。

example: The police have launched an inquiry into the accident.
description: 警方已對這起事故展開調查。

example: The book provides a deep insight into human nature.
description: 這本書提供了對人性的深刻見解（洞察）。

example: He insists that he is telling the truth.
description: 他堅持自己說的是實話。

example: Her success has inspired many young people.
description: 她的成功啟發（鼓舞）了許多青年。

example: The company is going to install a new software system.
description: 公司打算安裝一套新的軟體系統。

example: This is a clear instance of how the law can be misused.
description: 這是一個關於法律如何被誤用的清楚實例（例子）。

example: He works at a research institute for cancer.
description: 他在一間癌症研究機構工作。

example: The university is a major educational institution.
description: 這所大學是一所主要的教育機構。

example: Every car owner must have car insurance.
description: 每位車主都必須投保汽車保險。

example: The intended audience for the book is young children.
description: 這本書的預期（打算針對的）讀者群是幼兒。

example: The heat from the sun was very intense.
description: 太陽的熱氣非常強烈。

example: The company is conducting an internal investigation.
description: 公司正在進行一項內部調查。

example: How do you interpret this poem?
description: 你如何解釋（詮釋）這首詩？

example: I’m sorry to interrupt, but I have a question.
description: 很抱歉打斷你，但我有一個問題。

example: The investigation into the crime is ongoing.
description: 對這起犯罪的調查正在進行中。

example: Buying a house is a big investment.
description: 買房子是一項巨大的投資。

example: The police have issued a warning about the storm.
description: 警方已發布了關於風暴的警告。

example: The children's faces were full of joy when they saw the presents.
description: 孩子們看到禮物時，臉上充滿了喜悅。

example: You should trust your own judgment when making decisions.
description: 在做決定時，你應該相信自己的判斷。

chinese: 資歷較淺的、地位較低的
example: She started her career as a junior reporter at a local newspaper.
description: 她的職業生涯是從當地報社的資淺（初級）記者開始的。

example: They are fighting for social justice and equal rights.
description: 他們正在為社會正義和平等權利而奮鬥。

example: How can you justify spending so much money on a car?
description: 你如何證明花這麼多錢買車是有道理的（為此辯解）？

example: The price of the product includes both materials and labor.
description: 產品的價格包含了材料和勞工（勞動）成本。

example: The artist painted a beautiful landscape of the mountains.
description: 這位藝術家畫了一幅美麗的山脈風景（景觀）。

example: The success of the project was largely due to your hard work.
description: 這個專案的成功主要地（大部分）歸功於你的努力。

chinese: 最新消息、最新的事物 (adj. 為 B1)
example: Have you heard the latest? The company is moving to a new office.
description: 你聽說最新消息（最新的狀況）了嗎？公司要搬到新辦公室了。

example: The company is going to launch a new product next month.
description: 公司打算在下個月發表（發起）一項新產品。

example: The country needs strong leadership during this crisis.
description: 在這次危機中，國家需要強大的領導力。

example: Our team finished at the top of the league this year.
description: 我們球隊今年在聯賽（聯盟）中名列前茅。

example: She leaned against the wall and waited for the bus.
description: 她倚靠在牆上等待公車。

example: The soldier was granted a short leave to visit his family.
description: 這名士兵獲准休短暫的假期去探望家人。

chinese: 使平坦、夷平 (n. 為 A2)
example: The old buildings were leveled to make room for a new park.
description: 舊建築被夷平（使平坦）以騰出空間建造新公園。

example: You must have a valid driver's license to drive a car.
description: 你必須持有有效的駕駛執照才能開車。

example: The store has a limited number of copies of the book.
description: 這家店這本書的副本（數量）有限。

example: The streets were lined with people waiting for the parade.
description: 街道兩旁排列著等待遊行的群眾。

example: The city has a lively nightlife with many bars and clubs.
description: 這座城市有著熱鬧的（活潑的）夜生活，有許多酒吧和俱樂部。

example: The truck was carrying a heavy load of bricks.
description: 卡車正載著沉重的一擔（裝載量）磚塊。

example: She took out a loan from the bank to buy a new car.
description: 她向銀行辦理了貸款來買新車。

example: The conclusion of the report is very logical.
description: 報告的結論非常合乎邏輯。

example: We need to find a long-term solution to the problem.
description: 我們需要找到這個問題的長期解決方案。

example: The screw is loose and needs to be tightened.
description: 螺絲鬆了，需要鎖緊。

example: The lord of the manor lived in a large castle.
description: 莊園的領主住在一座大城堡裡。

example: The temperature reached a new low last night.
description: 昨晚氣溫達到了新的低點。

example: The store has decided to lower the price of the products.
description: 商店決定降低產品的價格。

example: Smoking can cause serious damage to your lungs.
description: 吸菸會對你的肺部造成嚴重損害。

example: It is important to maintain a healthy diet and exercise regularly.
description: 維持健康的飲食並規律運動是非常重要的。

chinese: 主修科目、少校 (adj. 為 A2)
example: Her major in college was international relations.
description: 她在大學的主修科目是國際關係。

example: The majority of the students in the class are from Asia.
description: 班上大多數（過半數）的學生來自亞洲。

example: What make of car do you drive?
description: 你開的是什麼品牌（型號）的車？

chinese: 繪製地圖、詳細規劃 (n. 為 A1)
example: Scientists are working to map the human genome.
description: 科學家們正致力於繪製（詳細規劃）人類基因組圖譜。

example: The project was designed for mass production.
description: 這個專案是為了大規模（大量）生產而設計的。

example: The earthquake caused massive damage to the city.
description: 地震對這座城市造成了巨大的（大規模的）損害。

example: It takes years of practice to master a foreign language.
description: 要精通一門外語需要多年的練習。

example: She bought a matching hat and gloves for the winter.
description: 她為冬天買了一套相配的（成套的）帽子和手套。

chinese: 物質的、實質的 (n. 為 A2)
example: The company’s material assets include buildings and equipment.
description: 公司的物質（實質）資產包括建築和設備。

example: The maximum speed limit on this highway is 70 miles per hour.
description: 這條公路的最高（最大值）速限是每小時 70 英哩。

example: Television is an effective means of communication.
description: 電視是一種有效的溝通手段（方法）。

example: The engineer took precise measurements of the room.
description: 工程師對房間進行了精確的測量（尺寸記錄）。

example: Advertising is a powerful medium for spreading information.
description: 廣告是傳播資訊的一種強大媒介。

example: The snow began to melt as the temperature rose.
description: 隨著氣溫升高，雪開始融化了。

example: The country is increasing its military spending.
description: 該國正在增加其軍事支出。

example: The region is rich in natural minerals like coal and iron.
description: 該地區富含煤和鐵等天然礦物。

example: The minimum age for voting in the election is eighteen.
description: 選舉投票的最低（最小值）年齡是十八歲。

example: The minister of education announced a new policy for schools.
description: 教育部長宣布了一項針對學校的新政策。

example: She suffered only minor injuries in the car accident.
description: 她在車禍中僅受了較小的（輕微的）傷。

example: Only a small minority of people supported the new law.
description: 只有極少數（少數人）支持這項新法律。

example: The astronauts successfully completed their mission to the moon.
description: 太空人們成功完成了他們的登月任務。

example: I mistook him for his brother because they look so much alike.
description: 我把他誤認（弄錯）成他弟弟了，因為他們長得太像了。

example: The film received mixed reviews from the critics.
description: 這部電影收到了評論家們褒貶不一（混合/複雜）的評價。

example: We need to modify the original plan to save costs.
description: 我們需要修改原始計畫以節省成本。

example: The doctors are monitoring the patient's condition closely.
description: 醫生們正在密切監控病人的狀況。

example: The story has a strong moral lesson for children.
description: 這個故事對孩子們有著強烈的道德教訓（寓意）。

chinese: 馬達、發動機、肌肉運動的
example: The toy car is powered by a small electric motor.
description: 這輛玩具車是由一個小型電力馬達驅動的。

example: Tension between the two countries continues to mount.
description: 兩國之間的緊張局勢持續增加（攀升）。

example: The victim suffered multiple injuries in the attack.
description: 受害者在襲擊中受了多處（多個）傷。

example: If you multiply five by four, you get twenty.
description: 如果你用五乘以四，你會得到二十。

example: The gap between the two teams has narrowed recently.
description: 這兩支球隊之間的差距最近縮小了。

example: The hotel welcomes many foreign nationals during the summer.
description: 這家飯店在夏天接待許多外國國民（外籍人士）。

chinese: 否定、底片、負面事物 (adj. 為 A1)
example: The film was a negative of a photograph taken years ago.
description: 這底片（負面影像）是多年前拍的照片原片。

example: It takes a lot of nerve to speak in front of such a large crowd.
description: 在這麼多人面前演講需要很大的勇氣（膽量）。

example: The task was difficult; nevertheless, we finished it on time.
description: 這項任務很困難；儘管如此（然而），我們還是準時完成了。

example: The traffic jam was a complete nightmare.
description: 那次塞車簡直是一場噩夢（可怕的經歷）。

example: I have no notion of what he is talking about.
description: 我完全不明白（沒有想法）他在說什麼。

example: He has won numerous awards for his scientific research.
description: 他因科學研究而獲得了許多項獎項。

example: Soldiers are expected to obey orders without question.
description: 士兵被要求不加質疑地服從（遵守）命令。

example: Many local residents object to the new housing development.
description: 許多當地居民反對（不贊成）這項新的住宅開發案。

example: The main objective of the meeting is to find a solution.
description: 會議的主要目標是找到解決方案。

example: We have a legal obligation to pay our taxes.
description: 我們有法律上的義務（責任）去繳稅。

example: She spent several years in the forest for the observation of birds.
description: 為了觀察鳥類，她在森林裡待了幾年。

example: Scientists observed the behavior of the animals for months.
description: 科學家們對這些動物的行為觀察了數個月。

example: You must obtain permission from the manager before leaving.
description: 離開前你必須獲得（得到）經理的許可。

example: We go to the theater occasionally but not very often.
description: 我們偶爾會去劇院，但並非經常。

example: I’m sorry if I offended you with my remarks.
description: 如果我的言論冒犯（得罪）了你，我很抱歉。

example: Driving without a license is a serious offense.
description: 無照駕駛是一項嚴重的罪行。

chinese: 冒犯的、無理的、攻擊性的
example: The politician’s comments were considered highly offensive.
description: 這位政治人物的言論被認為具有高度的冒犯性。

example: A government official confirmed the news this morning.
description: 一位政府官員今天早上證實了這則消息。

example: The company has an opening for a sales manager.
description: 公司有一個業務經理的空缺。

example: The machine is easy to operate.
description: 這台機器很容易運作（操作）。

example: He defeated his opponent in the final match.
description: 他在決賽中擊敗了對手。

example: Many people oppose the construction of the new highway.
description: 許多人反對這條新公路的建設。

example: They are strongly opposed to the new tax law.
description: 他們強烈反對這項新稅法。

example: The proposal faced a lot of opposition from the public.
description: 這項提議面臨了來自公眾的許多反對。

example: The heart is a vital organ of the human body.
description: 心臟是人體至關重要的器官。

example: The origin of the word is Latin.
description: 這個單字的起源是拉丁語。

example: Please hurry up; otherwise, we’ll be late.
description: 請快一點；否則（不然）我們會遲到。

example: We are waiting for the outcome of the election.
description: 我們正在等待選舉的結果。

example: The outer layer of the skin is very thin.
description: 皮膚的外層（外部）非常薄。

example: The professor gave a brief outline of the course.
description: 教授對這門課程進行了簡短的概述（大綱）。

example: The overall performance of the team was excellent.
description: 團隊的整體表現非常出色。

example: I owe you an apology for being late.
description: 我欠你一個道歉，因為我遲到了。

example: He found it difficult to keep up with the pace of the class.
description: 他發現很難跟上這門課的進度（步調）。

example: The new software is packaged with several useful tools.
description: 這款新軟體與幾項實用的工具包裝在一起。

example: A panel of experts was appointed to review the safety procedures.
description: 一個專家小組被委派來審查安全程序。

example: All participants in the study were asked to sign a consent form.
description: 研究中的所有參與者都被要求簽署一份同意書。

example: The project’s failure was partly due to a lack of funding.
description: 該專案的失敗部分歸因於缺乏資金。

example: The dark passage led to a small, hidden room.
description: 這條陰暗的通道通往一個隱蔽的小房間。

example: You need to be patient and wait for the right opportunity.
description: 你需要有耐心，等待合適的時機。

example: He is looking for a permanent place to live.
description: 他正在尋找一個永久的居住地。

example: The city council granted a permit for the building project.
description: 市議會核發了該建築計畫的許可證。

example: The experience gave her a new perspective on life.
description: 這次經歷給了她對人生的新觀點（看法）。

example: The first phase of the project is now complete.
description: 專案的第一階段現在已經完成了。

example: Social media is a relatively recent phenomenon.
description: 社群媒體是一個相對近期的現象。

example: She studied philosophy at university.
description: 她在大學學習哲學。

example: You can have your pick of any of the cakes.
description: 你可以隨意挑選（選擇）任何蛋糕。

example: It’s hard to picture what the city was like a hundred years ago.
description: 很難想像這座城市一百年前是什麼樣子。

example: There was a large pile of old books in the corner.
description: 角落裡有一大堆舊書。

example: The football pitch was muddy after the heavy rain.
description: 大雨過後，足球場一片泥濘。

example: The instructions were written in plain English.
description: 這些說明是用簡單清楚的英文寫成的。

chinese: 策劃、繪製圖表 (n. 為 B1) (p. 8)
example: The rebels were plotting to overthrow the government.
description: 叛軍正策劃推翻政府。

chinese: 有利的、加上的 (prep. 為 B1) (p. 8)
example: One of the plus points of the house is its large garden.
description: 這棟房子的優點（有利因素）之一是它的大花園。

example: The fence was made of pointed metal bars.
description: 圍欄是由尖銳的鐵條製成的。

example: The popularity of video games has grown rapidly.
description: 電子遊戲的受歡迎程度（普及度）增長迅速。

example: Plastic waste poses a serious threat to marine life.
description: 塑膠垃圾對海洋生物造成了嚴重的威脅。

example: The troops were positioned around the city.
description: 部隊被安置在城市四周。

chinese: 正面、優點、肯定 (adj. 為 A1) (p. 8)
example: We need to focus on the positives of the situation.
description: 我們需要專注於目前局勢的正面（優點）。

example: She possesses all the qualities of a good leader.
description: 她具有一位優秀領導者的所有特質。

example: The new product has the potential to be a great success.
description: 這款新產品有潛力取得巨大的成功。

chinese: 為...提供動力 (n. 為 A2) (p. 8)
example: The car is powered by a hydrogen engine.
description: 這輛車是由氫氣引擎提供動力的。

example: The teacher gave her a lot of praise for her hard work.
description: 老師對她的努力給予了許多稱讚。

example: She is six months pregnant.
description: 她已經懷孕六個月了。

example: Careful preparation is the key to a successful meeting.
description: 周全的準備是會議成功的關鍵。

example: Your presence is requested at the meeting.
description: 誠摯邀請您出席會議。

example: We must take steps to preserve our natural environment.
description: 我們必須採取措施來保護我們的自然環境。

example: The tickets are priced at twenty dollars each.
description: 門票定價為每張二十美元。

example: The prime suspect in the case was arrested yesterday.
description: 該案的主要嫌疑犯已於昨日被逮捕。

chinese: 最重要的、主要的 (n. 為 B1) (p. 8)
example: The principal aim of the project is to reduce costs.
description: 該專案的主要（最重要的）目標是降低成本。

example: He refused to help them as a matter of principle.
description: 基於原則問題，他拒絕幫助他們。

chinese: 印刷品、字體、腳印 (v. 為 A2) (p. 8)
example: The book is available in large print for older readers.
description: 這本書有大字體（印刷）版，供年長讀者閱讀。

example: Safety is our top priority.
description: 安全是我們最優先的考量（優先事項）。

example: The house is surrounded by a high wall to ensure privacy.
description: 房子四周圍繞著高牆以確保隱私。

example: You must follow the correct procedure for applying for a visa.
description: 你必須遵循正確的程序來申請簽證。

example: The application will be processed within ten working days.
description: 申請將在十個工作天內處理完畢。

chinese: 生產、製造 (B2 用法：出示、提出) (p. 8)
example: He was asked to produce his passport at the border.
description: 他被要求在邊境出示他的護照。

example: The company is looking for a professional with experience in marketing.
description: 公司正在尋找一位具有行銷經驗的專業人士。

example: Spending is projected to rise by five percent next year.
description: 支出預計明年將增長百分之五。

example: The police have no proof that he committed the crime.
description: 警方沒有證據證明他犯了罪。

example: The committee rejected the proposal for a new stadium.
description: 委員會否決了新建體育場的提案。

example: The government proposed a new tax law last week.
description: 政府上週提議了一項新稅法。

example: The prospect of a long holiday made her very happy.
description: 對長假的展望（期待）讓她非常開心。

example: The helmet provides protection for your head.
description: 安全帽能為你的頭部提供保護。

example: The psychologist helped her deal with her anxiety.
description: 心理學家幫助她應對焦慮。

example: He is studying child psychology at university.
description: 他在大學學習兒童心理學。

example: The publication of the report was delayed by a week.
description: 報告的發表延遲了一週。

example: Tickets can be purchased online or at the box office.
description: 門票可以線上購買或在售票處購買。

example: The ring is made of pure gold.
description: 這枚戒指是由純金製成的。

example: She decided to pursue a career in medicine.
description: 她決定追求醫學領域的職業生涯。

chinese: 範圍在...之間、排列 (n. 為 B1)
example: The students' ages range from 18 to 25.
description: 學生的年齡範圍在 18 到 25 歲之間。

example: She held a high rank in the army.
description: 她在軍中擁有很高的等級（軍階）。

example: The city has seen rapid growth in the last decade.
description: 這座城市在過去十年中經歷了快速的增長。

example: The technology is changing rapidly.
description: 這項技術正在迅速地改變。

example: The film was rated as one of the best of the year.
description: 這部電影被評價為年度最佳影片之一。

example: Raw meat must be kept separate from cooked food.
description: 生肉必須與熟食分開存放。

example: Keep the medicine out of the reach of children.
description: 請將藥物放在兒童觸及範圍之外的地方。

example: We need to set realistic goals for the project.
description: 我們需要為這個專案設定現實的（可達成的）目標。

chinese: 合理的、講道理的、不貴的
example: The price of the meal was very reasonable.
description: 這頓飯的價格非常合理（不貴）。

example: I cannot recall where I met him before.
description: 我回想不起（記不起來）以前在哪裡見過他。

example: It took her several weeks to recover from the surgery.
description: 她花了幾個星期才從手術中康復（恢復）。

example: There has been a significant reduction in crime this year.
description: 今年犯罪率有了顯著的減少（下降）。

example: He is highly regarded by his colleagues.
description: 他深受同事們的看重（尊重）。

example: The company has several regional offices across the country.
description: 這間公司在全國各地設有幾個地區辦事處。

example: You must register for the course by Friday.
description: 你必須在週五前註冊這門課程。

example: I regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful.
description: 我很遺憾地通知您，您的申請未獲通過。

example: The government has introduced new safety regulations.
description: 政府推出了新的安全規章（準則）。

example: The exam was relatively easy compared to last year.
description: 與去年相比，這次考試相對地簡單。

example: Please provide all the relevant information for your case.
description: 請提供與您的案件相關的所有資訊。

example: It was a great relief to hear that they were safe.
description: 聽到他們平安無事，真是一大寬慰。

example: You can rely on him to finish the job on time.
description: 你可以依靠（信任）他準時完成工作。

example: The critics made several positive remarks about the film.
description: 評論家對這部電影發表了幾項正面的評論（言論）。

example: She is the elected representative for our district.
description: 她是我們選區選出的代表。

example: The restaurant has a good reputation for its seafood.
description: 這家餐廳的海鮮享有很好的名聲（聲望）。

example: A college degree is a basic requirement for this job.
description: 大學學位是這份工作的基本要求（必要條件）。

example: The firemen managed to rescue the cat from the tree.
description: 消防員設法從樹上營救了那隻貓。

example: The national park is a famous wildlife reserve.
description: 這座國家公園是著名的野生動物保護區（保留區）。

example: The local residents are happy with the new park.
description: 當地居民對新公園感到很滿意。

example: It's hard to resist eating chocolate when it's right in front of you.
description: 當巧克力就在你面前時，很難抗拒不去吃它。

example: We need to find a way to resolve the conflict peacefully.
description: 我們需要找到一個和平解決衝突的方法。

example: We stayed at a beautiful beach resort during the summer.
description: 夏天我們住在一個美麗的海濱度假勝地。

example: The company aims to retain its best employees.
description: 公司旨在保留其最優秀的員工。

example: The investigation revealed the truth about the accident.
description: 調查揭露了關於這起事故的真相。

example: The industrial revolution changed the way people lived.
description: 工業革命改變了人們的生活方式。

example: There is a reward for anyone who finds the missing dog.
description: 任何人找到失蹤的狗都會得到獎勵。

example: She danced to the rhythm of the music.
description: 她隨著音樂的節奏起舞。

example: We need to rid the garden of weeds.
description: 我們需要除去花園裡的雜草。

example: There has been a sharp rise in the cost of living.
description: 生活成本有了急劇的上升（增加）。

example: The root of the problem is a lack of trust.
description: 問題的根源（核心）是缺乏信任。

example: He won the first round of the boxing match.
description: 他贏了拳擊比賽的第一個回合（輪）。

chinese: 常規的、例行的 (n. 為 A1)
example: The check-up is just a routine medical procedure.
description: 這次檢查只是常規的（例行的）醫療程序。

example: He rubbed his eyes because he was tired.
description: 因為累了，他揉了揉眼睛。

example: The soles of the shoes are made of rubber.
description: 鞋底是由橡膠製成的。

example: She lives in a small rural community.
description: 她住在一個小型的鄉村社區。

example: There's no need to rush; we have plenty of time.
description: 不需要倉促（趕時間）；我們有充裕的時間。

chinese: 抽樣檢查、品嚐 (n. 為 B1)
example: The organization samples the river water every month.
description: 該機構每個月都會對河水進行抽樣檢查。

example: The weather forecast is based on information from satellites.
description: 天氣預報是根據來自衛星的資訊。

example: The manager was very satisfied with the team's performance.
description: 經理對團隊的表現感到非常滿意。

example: The company is working hard to satisfy its customers.
description: 公司正努力使客戶滿意（滿足客戶需求）。

example: The new machine resulted in a significant saving of time.
description: 這台新機器大大節省（節省量）了時間。

example: The project was carried out on a global scale.
description: 該專案是在全球規模（範圍）下進行的。

example: The meeting is scheduled for next Tuesday.
description: 會議安排（排定）在下週二。

example: She screamed in terror when she saw the spider.
description: 她看到蜘蛛時恐懼地尖叫。

example: The candidates are screened before the final interview.
description: 候選人在最終面試前會經過篩選（審查）。

chinese: 使就座、容納 (n. 為 A2)
example: The auditorium seats five hundred people.
description: 這個禮堂可容納（使就座）五百人。

example: The private sector plays a vital role in the economy.
description: 私營部門（領域）在經濟中扮演至關重要的角色。

example: The company managed to secure a large contract.
description: 公司設法獲得（確保）了一份大合約。

example: They are seeking a professional for the new position.
description: 他們正在為新職位尋求（尋找）專業人士。

example: The committee will select the best candidate for the job.
description: 委員會將為這份工作選拔（選擇）最佳人選。

example: The store offers a wide selection of organic vegetables.
description: 這家店提供多樣化的有機蔬菜選擇（精選品）。

example: He has a very strong sense of self.
description: 他有著非常強烈的自我（自覺）意識。

example: The bill was passed by the senate yesterday.
description: 該法案昨天由參議院通過。

example: The senator gave a speech on the new tax law.
description: 這位參議員就新稅法發表了演說。

example: She is a senior executive at a large bank.
description: 她是大型銀行的資深（高階）主管。

chinese: 感覺到、察覺到 (n. 為 A2)
example: He sensed that something was wrong.
description: 他察覺到（感覺到）有些事情不對勁。

example: She is very sensitive to other people's feelings.
description: 她對別人的感受非常敏感（體貼）。

example: The judge sentenced him to five years in prison.
description: 法官判處（宣判）他五年有期徒刑。

example: The events happened in a logical sequence.
description: 這些事件按邏輯順序（序列）發生。

example: The training session lasted for three hours.
description: 培訓課（期間）持續了三個小時。

example: They finally managed to settle the dispute.
description: 他們終於設法解決了爭議。

example: The country is facing a severe shortage of water.
description: 國家正面臨嚴重的缺水問題。

chinese: 陰影、陰涼處、色調 (v. 為 B2)
example: Let's sit in the shade of that tree.
description: 我們坐在那棵樹的陰涼處（陰影下）吧。

example: The long shadows stretched across the grass.
description: 長長的影子（陰影）延伸過草地。

example: We shall never forget your kindness.
description: 我們將永遠不會忘記你的善意。

example: The river is very shallow at this point.
description: 這條河在此處非常淺。

example: It’s a shame that you can’t come to the party.
description: 你不能來參加派對真是一件遺憾（可惜）的事。

example: Our early experiences help to shape our character.
description: 我們早期的經歷有助於塑造我們的性格。

example: We took shelter from the rain under a large tree.
description: 我們在大樹下躲避（遮蓋）雨水。

example: The focus of the discussion shifted to the budget.
description: 討論的焦點轉移（改變）到了預算上。

example: The goods will be shipped next week.
description: 貨物將於下週運送（郵寄）。

example: The news of his death came as a great shock.
description: 他去世的消息令人感到非常震驚。

example: I was deeply shocked by what I saw.
description: 我對所見到的景象感到深深的震驚。

chinese: 射擊、照片、嘗試 (v. 為 B1)
example: The photographer took a brilliant shot of the mountains.
description: 攝影師拍了一張精彩的山景照片（鏡頭）。

example: There has been a significant increase in sales.
description: 銷量有了顯著的（重要的）增長。

example: The price of the house has dropped significantly.
description: 房子的價格已經顯著地（相當地）下降了。

example: There was a long silence before she spoke.
description: 在她說話之前有一段很長的沉默（安靜）。

example: The dress is made of pure silk.
description: 這件洋裝是由純絲綢製成的。

example: Please accept my sincere apologies for the delay.
description: 請接受我對這次延誤的真誠（誠懇）道歉。

example: The glass slid across the table and fell on the floor.
description: 玻璃杯在桌上滑動，然後掉到了地板上。

example: There has been a slight change in the schedule.
description: 行程有了輕微的（微小的）變動。

example: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.
description: 小心別在濕的地板上滑倒。

example: The house is built on a steep slope.
description: 這棟房子建在一個陡峭的斜坡上。

example: The results were somewhat disappointing.
description: 結果有點（稍微）令人失望。

example: Music is good for the soul.
description: 音樂有益於靈魂（心靈）。

chinese: 拿、取 (B2 用法：忍受、接納)
example: I don’t think I can take much more of this noise.
description: 我想我再也無法忍受（接納）這種噪音了。

example: The old man told us an amazing tale of his travels.
description: 那位老人給我們講了一個關於他旅行的驚人故事。

example: The car’s gas tank is almost empty.
description: 汽車的油箱（大水槽）快空了。

chinese: 把...作為目標 (n. 為 A2)
example: The advertisement is targeted at young professionals.
description: 這則廣告是把年輕專業人士作為目標（針對）。

example: He has been termed a genius by his colleagues.
description: 他被同事們稱為（命名）天才。

example: Physical therapy can help people recover from injuries.
description: 物理治療（療法）可以幫助人們從傷病中康復。

example: Pollution is a serious threat to the environment.
description: 污染對環境是一個嚴重的威脅。

example: The tall trees threatened to fall during the storm.
description: 大雨中，那些高大的樹木有倒塌的威脅（危險）。

example: The oil price has fallen; thus, travel costs should decrease.
description: 油價已經下跌；因此（從而），交通成本應該會降低。

chinese: 為...安排時間、計時 (n. 為 A1)
example: The experiment was timed to last for exactly one hour.
description: 實驗被安排時間（計時）為正好持續一小時。

chinese: 加標題於、賦予頭銜 (n. 為 A1)
example: The author hasn’t titled his new book yet.
description: 作者還沒為他的新書加標題（命名）。

example: She spoke in a very friendly tone of voice.
description: 她用非常友善的語氣（腔調）說話。

example: It was a tough decision to make, but it was necessary.
description: 那是一個艱難的（辛苦的）決定，但卻是必要的。

example: The software can track your daily expenses easily.
description: 這款軟體可以輕鬆追蹤你的日常開支。

example: He has been transferred to the company's New York office.
description: 他被調動（轉移）到了公司的紐約辦公室。

example: The new technology has transformed the way we communicate.
description: 這項新技術改變了（轉化了）我們溝通的方式。

example: The country is in the middle of a transition to a new government.
description: 這個國家正處於向新政府過渡（轉變）的階段。

example: The trial of the suspect will begin next week.
description: 嫌疑人的審判（審理）將於下週開始。

example: Be careful not to trip over the wires on the floor.
description: 小心別被地板上的電線絆倒。

example: The island is famous for its tropical fruits.
description: 這座島嶼以其熱帶的水果聞名。

chinese: 麻煩、使煩惱 (n. 為 A2)
example: I’m sorry to trouble you, but could you help me?
description: 很抱歉麻煩（打擾）你，但你能幫我嗎？

example: I am truly grateful for all your help.
description: 我對你所有的幫助真心地（確實地）感激。

example: A successful marriage is built on mutual trust.
description: 成功的婚姻建立在相互的信任（信賴）之上。

example: It’s worth a try, even if we are not sure it will work.
description: 即使我們不確定會成功，也值得一試（嘗試）。

example: She hummed a catchy tune while she worked.
description: 她在工作時哼著一段動聽的曲調（旋律）。

example: The train went through a long tunnel in the mountain.
description: 火車穿過山裡的一條長隧道。

example: The decision ultimately rests with the manager.
description: 這項決定最終（最後）由經理負責。

example: He was knocked unconscious in the car accident.
description: 他在車禍中被撞得失去知覺（無意識）。

example: We faced some unexpected problems during the trip.
description: 我們在旅途中遇到了一些出乎意料的（意外的）問題。

example: Each person's fingerprints are unique.
description: 每個人的指紋都是獨一無二的（獨特的）。

example: Scientists are still exploring the mysteries of the universe.
description: 科學家們仍在探索宇宙的奧秘。

example: The cause of the fire is still unknown.
description: 起火原因目前仍然未知（不詳）。

example: The upper floors of the building are used for offices.
description: 這棟建築的較高（上層）樓層被用作辦公室。

example: The price of oil has shown an upward trend.
description: 油價呈現出向上（增長）的趨勢。

example: The government is planning to improve urban transportation.
description: 政府正計畫改善都市（城鎮）交通。

example: The report urges the government to take immediate action.
description: 該報告催促（力勸）政府立即採取行動。

example: I value your opinion very much.
description: 我非常重視（看重）你的意見。

example: We hired a van to move our furniture to the new house.
description: 我們租了一輛廂型車（貨車）把家具搬到新家。

example: The prices of the products vary from store to store.
description: 產品的價格因商店而異（有所變化）。

example: The vast majority of people supported the new law.
description: 絕大多數（巨大比例）的人支持這項新法律。

example: The stadium is a popular venue for concerts.
description: 這座體育場是舉辦音樂會的熱門場地（場館）。

chinese: 正是、恰好是 (adv. 為 A1)
example: This is the very thing I was looking for.
description: 這恰好（正是）我一直在找的東西。

example: The news was sent to us via email.
description: 這則消息是透過（經由）電子郵件傳送給我們的。

example: The team celebrated their victory in the final match.
description: 球隊慶祝了他們在決賽中的勝利。

example: The government is trying to reduce violence in schools.
description: 政府正努力減少校園暴力。

example: The website offers a virtual tour of the museum.
description: 該網站提供博物館的虛擬導覽。

example: The leader had a clear vision for the country's future.
description: 這位領導人對國家的未來有著清晰的遠見（願景）。

example: The book is full of beautiful visual images.
description: 這本書充滿了美麗的視覺圖像。

chinese: 至關重要的、充滿活力的
example: Trust is a vital component of a healthy relationship.
description: 信任是健康關係中至關重要的元素。

example: Fresh fruit and vegetables are full of vitamins.
description: 新鮮蔬菜水果富含維生素。

example: Please turn down the volume of the television.
description: 請調低電視的音量。

example: They are fighting for a fair minimum wage.
description: 他們正在爭取公平的最低工資（薪水）。

chinese: 遠遠地、非常 (n. 為 A1)
example: The price is way too high for me.
description: 這價格對我來說遠遠地（非常）太高了。

example: The interview helps to identify the candidate's weaknesses.
description: 面試有助於識別候選人的弱點。

example: His wealth comes from his successful software company.
description: 他的財富來自於他成功的軟體公司。

example: She comes from a very wealthy family.
description: 她出身於一個非常富有的家庭。

example: He loves adventure, whereas his brother prefers to stay home.
description: 他熱愛冒險，然而（但是）他的弟弟更喜歡待在家裡。

example: I will follow you wherever you go.
description: 無論你去哪裡，我都會跟隨你。

example: She spoke in a whisper so as not to wake the baby.
description: 她低聲說話（耳語），以免吵醒嬰兒。

example: The book is widely considered to be a masterpiece.
description: 這本書被廣泛地認為是一部傑作。

example: The national park is home to a wide range of wildlife.
description: 這座國家公園是各式各樣野生動植物的家園。

example: Are you willing to help us with the project?
description: 你樂意（自願）幫助我們完成這個專案嗎？

example: She wound the string around her finger.
description: 她將細繩纏繞在手指上。

example: The fence was made of barbed wire.
description: 圍牆是由帶刺的鐵絲（金屬線）製成的。

example: It was a wise decision to save money for the future.
description: 為了未來儲蓄金錢是一個明智的決定。

example: The police are looking for witnesses to the accident.
description: 警方正在尋找這起事故的目擊者。

example: The jewels are of great worth.
description: 這些珠寶具有極大的價值。

example: The soldier was treated for a leg wound.
description: 士兵接受了腿部傷口的治療。

example: He wrapped the gift in beautiful paper.
description: 他用漂亮的紙把禮物包了起來。

chinese: 錯誤、不義行為 (adj. 為 A1)
example: There is a clear difference between right and wrong.
description: 對與錯（不義行為）之間有明顯的區別。

example: It's a small house, yet it's very comfortable.
description: 這是一間小房子，然而（但是）它非常舒適。

example: The city center is a no-parking zone.
description: 市中心是禁止停車地帶（區域）。
